title: UKPNP High Level Delegation Briefs British MPs on Kashmir Crisis and Current Situation in London House of Parliament
excerpt: A high-level UKPNP delegation led by Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri briefed British MPs in the House of Parliament on the Kashmir crisis, human rights concerns, and the current political situation.
author: London Correspondent

heroImage.caption: UKPNP delegation meeting British MPs inside the UK Parliament.

body.text: A high-level delegation of the United Kashmir People's National Party (UKPNP) met British Members of Parliament in the House of Commons to brief them on the ongoing Kashmir crisis and the deteriorating human rights situation.
The delegation highlighted concerns regarding political repression, communication blackouts, and the humanitarian impact of prolonged restrictions across the region.

body.caption: Delegation members presenting documents to MPs.

body.text: British MPs expressed serious concern and called for renewed international attention to the region, emphasizing democratic rights and civilian protection.
